content: Nebius from India (measured from builder machine 2026-09-24): TCP RTT to api.tokenfactory.nebius.com ~200ms, TLS+TTFB for unauthenticated GET ~0.6-1.2s; HTTP 401 on /v1/models without key, so endpoint reachable without VPN/proxy. Practical implications: streaming responses needed, keep-alive connection reuse, minimize sequential round trips per report. Billing: $25 minimum top-up, international card needed (RBI rules can block recurring auto-top-up - manual one-time payments; enable international usage on card). Builder already has $25 credits via Builder Program.
